content: यात {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Gone, marched, walked. .²2 Passed, departed, gone away. .²3 Passed by, elapsed. .²4 Attained, reduced or gone to (a state <ab>&c.</ab>). (See या). .{@-तम्@} .²1 Going, motion; विद्वान् विदामास शनैर्न यातम् <ls>Śi. 3. 32</ls>; यातं यच्च नितम्बयोर्गुरुतया <ls>Ś. 2. 2</ls>. .²2 A march. .²3 The act of driving an elephant with a goad; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 8. 22</ls>. .²4 The past time.
